registered: 2026-10-14, before any stage-1 code was written or run

main.month_line: for month m (v2.month_steps membership, main step method, step_mean not NaN, setpoint 45) with >=3 steps: Theil-Sen slope over (days since first step, step_mean); intercept = median(s_i - slope*t_i); L_m = line value at CK_(m+1) date 00:00
main.validity: exactly V2's: previous month k-2 has >=3 45 C steps and d(k-2) <= 10 days; current month k-1 has d(k-1) <= 10 days or >=3 steps; anchor k-1 visible and at 25 C
main.current_month_lt3: if month k-1 has <3 45 C steps, its value is V2's E45 + r*d with r = 0 (V2 uses r only when n>=3), i.e. E45(k-1); month k-2 always uses its line
main.prediction: Q = Q_fc(k-1) + eps + beta_k * (L_(k-1) - L_(k-2)); beta_k = v2.beta_a4(fc, a4[2.0], ck, k, 1.0, 1.0)
main.fallback: V2 unchanged (M4) when the branch is not valid

variants.last3: line over the last 3 steps of each month only
variants.at_last_plus_rate: line values at each month's last step time, then V2's rate term r*(d(k-1)-d(k-2)) with V2's r

gates: common gates vs V2 (prompt section 5), incl. G-pseudo on PG1/PG2 (k=4..7) and PC5/PC10 (k=3..7)
diagnostic: report per-month slope and intercept residual SD to see whether slope or intercept noise drives the change
